notes: BTP-001 (beta-clamp targeting antimicrobial peptide) labelled abx_other; R11 cell-penetrating peptide labelled other_chemical. Untreated control samples at every time point and the '1 min pre-treatment' samples of the BTP-001 cultures are untreated controls. Phase mid_exponential for all: design states treatments at OD 0.2 'to ensure exponential growth during the entire sampling period'. Temperature not given. WT re-read: unmodified MG1655 (genotype Wild type) set to wild_type.

base_medium.q: E. coli was grown in cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth in 1 1L Applikon bioreactors as batch culitvation.

medium_class.q: E. coli was grown in cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth

amino_acids_supplied.q: E. coli was grown in cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth

oxygen.q: Stirring was adjusted between 200 and 600 rpm to maintain a dissolved oxygen concentration above 40%.

growth_phase.q: All treatments were given at OD600 = 0.2 to ensure exponential growth during the entire sampling period.

inducer_added.q: we conducted RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) of E. coli MG1655 treated with 2 doses of the novel antibiotic peptide BTP-001 and 1 dose of the cell penetrating peptide R11
